dataset.summary: 56 distinct synthetic documents, 20 forensic fixtures, 12 demo applications. Simulated sources; no real-world accuracy claim.

extraction.detail: 225/227 scalar text fields match using the production normaliser (not strict character equality); missing fields count as errors. Classification: 56/56 documents.

validation.detail: 32/39 scenario expectations detected by kind and target. Coverage proxy only: free-text labels are incomplete; precision/F1 need exhaustive adjudication.

anomaly.headline: 100.0% precision
anomaly.detail: Recall 41.7%; clean false-positive rate 0.0%. TP 5, FP 0, FN 7, TN 8; 20 forensic fixtures.

verification.detail: 32/42 conclusive simulated-source verdicts; expected-state accuracy 100.0%. EXPIRED: 2, MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: 7, MISMATCH_DETECTED: 5, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: 1, VERIFICATION_PENDING: 2, VERIFIED: 25

discrepancy.headline: 100.0% precision
discrepancy.detail: Source mismatches: TP 5, FP 0, FN 0. Record-mismatch precision still needs independent labels.

time.headline: 6.985s / document
time.detail: Stored ingestion durations, p95 25.646s (56 distinct files); fresh validation mean 0.144s, p95 0.318s (12 applications). Local Windows CPU run.

alerts.headline: Same transaction
alerts.detail: Code-confirmed transactional creation alongside findings. End-to-end alert delivery latency has not been measured; no seconds claim is made.

effort.headline: Estimate only
effort.detail: Assuming 12 manual minutes/document + 45 minutes/application: 2.07 manual hours/application before subtracting automated time. No officer time study yet.
